ana: Short heads-up: we're publishing a Private on‑prem readiness bulletin today. Focus areas: FedRAMP artifacts (readiness only), FIPS-mode options, and an air‑gapped installer checklist. Read and react if you need to join the initial validation cohort.

sam: Security summary: v2.5 supports a FIPS crypto path and HSM integrations. Customers can run in FIPS-mode when using a certified KMS or our partner HSM. Airgap installs require manual key rotation; document included.

laura: Legal note: approved wording for sales is in the bulletin. Do NOT state "FedRAMP authorized"  say "FedRAMP readiness artifacts available under NDA." We'll provide an addendum template.

jia: Ops note: pilot validation slots are limited. Canary pattern: 10% -> 40% -> full. Oncall: @jia primary, @oliver backup. Runbook link in the bulletin.

deploy-bot: "created: private-onprem-readiness-bulletin by ana at 2026-04-08T12:00Z"

ana: Internal walkthrough scheduled next Tue 10:00 PT  invite will include install demo and Q&A. If you handle pilot customers please attend.
